title: 数値処理
subtitle: Numerical Computing
keywords: Nonlinear Equations 2.Linear Equations 3.Data Fitting 4.Numerical Integration 5.Ordinary Differential Equations
educationalGoal: After taking this course, students should be able to: 1. Explain numerical algorithms 2. Use numerical algorithms appropriately 3. Evaluate the accuracy of the approximate solution
advice: This is a basic course on numerical computation. We will cover the following topics: 1. Nonlinear equations 2. Systems of linear equations 3. Data fitting 4. Numerical integration (quadrature) 5. Initial value problems for ordinary differential equations Students are expected to participate in class using a PC, textbook, and notebook.
books: Nara et al.: "Numerical Computation (in Japanese)", Asakura Publishing, ISBN 978-4-254-22732-1 (1991).
requiredKnowledge: Basic knowledge of linear algebra is preferred.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain numerical algorithms.
Be able to solve equations by using numerical algorithms appropriately.
Be able to evaluate the accuracy of the approximate solution.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Fully understand numerical algorithms, use them efficiently, and evaluate the accuracy of the solution appropriately. (2) Explain how to derive formulas.
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Generally understand numerical algorithms and use them. (2) Remember the formulas.

lessons.content: Course introduction Nonlinear equations (1) (based on intermediate value theorem) Bisection method
lessons.assignments: Review important points of bisection method through the report.

lessons.content: Nonlinear equations (2) (based on fixed point theorem) Newton-Raphson method
lessons.assignments: Review important points of the Newton-Raphson method through the report.

lessons.content: Systems of linear equations (1) (direct methods) Gaussian elimination method LU-factorization with partial pivoting
lessons.assignments: Review important points of LU-factorization through the report.

lessons.content: Systems of linear equations (2) (iteration methods) Jacobi method Gauss-Seidel method
lessons.assignments: Review important points of the Jacobi method and Gauss-Seidel method through the report.
Review important points of linear least squares through the report.
Review important points of the Lagrange interpolation formula through the report.

lessons.content: Data fitting (3) Newton’s divided difference Newton interpolation formula
lessons.assignments: Review important points of the Newton interpolation formula through the report.

lessons.content: Data fitting (4) Runge's phenomenon Cubic spline
lessons.assignments: Review important points of natural cubic splines through the report.

lessons.content: Numerical integration (1) (Newton-Cotes quadrature formula) Trapezoid rule Simpson's rule
lessons.assignments: Review important points of the trapezoid rule and Simpson's rule through the report.
Review important points of Gauss-Legendre quadrature through the report.

lessons.content: IVPs for ODEs (1) Euler's method Adams-Bashforth methods (1)
lessons.assignments: Review important points of Euler's method and AB methods through the report.

lessons.content: IVPs for ODEs (2) Adams-Bashforth methods (2) Runge-Kutta methods
lessons.assignments: Review important points of the AB methods and RK methods through the report.
